name: gorosary
description: GoRosary — the Rosary, novenas, and daily prayers for web and mobile.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @gorosary/content && npm run build --workspace @gorosary/ui
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @gorosary/web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @gorosary/mobile
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n web,mobile -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:mobile"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @gorosary/web
